purpose: Verify exact Windows Startup folder for the active profile and inspect whether a BLACK launcher already exists.
command:
set -e
P='/mnt/c/Users/eztra/AppData/Roaming/Microsoft/Windows/Start Menu/Programs/Startup'
printf 'EXISTS='; [ -d "$P" ] && echo yes || echo no
printf 'WRITABLE='; [ -w "$P" ] && echo yes || echo no
ls -la "$P" 2>/dev/null || true
printf 'LAUNCHER='; [ -f "$P/AMX-BLACK-WSL.cmd" ] && echo present || echo absent
if [ -f "$P/AMX-BLACK-WSL.cmd" ]; then cat "$P/AMX-BLACK-WSL.cmd"; fi
